results.observation: Public tool accepts a process-only authority classification and generic technical recovery is rejected.
Ledger has two resolutions; automatic child context carries only the last one.
Expired CI wait creates blocker with zero current remote observations.
Process obligations accept a string and arbitrary objects without semantic/type validation.
